headline: Revenue rises, profit cools q/q, buybacks lift EPS
summary_short: Domino's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose to $1,194M (+3.8% q/q, +4.3% y/y) while operating income grew a modest 0.7% q/q; net income of $136M fell 2.9% q/q but diluted EPS of $4.07 still rose 6.8% y/y as buybacks trimmed the share count.
summary_long: Revenue of $1,194M rose 3.8% q/q and 4.3% y/y, driven by higher supply-chain volumes/pricing and global franchise royalty growth, partly offset by lower U.S. company-owned store revenue from refranchising. Consolidated gross margin slipped 30bp q/q to 40.0% of revenue as U.S. company-owned margin fell 420bp on higher food and labor costs, cushioned by supply-chain margin gains. Operating income of $232M rose 0.7% q/q on segment growth, offset by G&A tied to the biennial Worldwide Rally. Net income of $136M fell 2.9% q/q on higher interest expense and a DPC Dash investment markdown; diluted EPS of $4.07 rose 6.8% y/y as buybacks ($156.2M this quarter) cut diluted shares 1.5% q/q. No forward guidance was given in the filing; cash was $164.8M.
